person.name: Robert Gray
person.tagline: Robert Gray can run the whole dark factory. A fleet of AI agents, a real team, or every station himself.
person.summary: Hands-on CTO with 20+ years building and modernising the software, platforms and teams that run commercial businesses. Owns technology strategy, risk and suppliers at board level, and still writes the code.

experience.title: Chief Technology Officer
experience.detail: Started at Directski.com, which merged with Topflight to form Topflight Travel Group. Never left. CTO since December 2014, Technical Project Manager from 2012 to 2014, Systems and Software Engineer from 2011 to 2012.

experience.title: IT Systems Administrator
experience.detail: Ran ICT systems and end-user support for 60+ staff at a national publisher.

experience.title: IT Administrator and Web Developer
experience.detail: Helped move the platform from Classic ASP to .NET and C#. Built websites and digital advertising campaigns.

experience.title: Technical Services Manager
experience.detail: Built, trained and led the support and installation teams for a wireless ISP serving remote locations.

education: MSc Leadership, Innovation and Technology, TU Dublin, First Class Honours. Thesis on what makes software outsourcing succeed.
BSc Computing, Dublin Business School, First Class Honours. Built an automated machine learning app that predicts and recommends selling prices.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt. Trained with Toyota and presented at EU-Japan Lean best-practice visits.
Sound Technology and Music Performance, Ballyfermot College of Further Education.
person.interests: Technology and lifelong learning, travel, the outdoors, skiing, cycling and music.

agents.title: CEO
agents.pitch: Sets the direction and keeps the whole factory pointed at it.
skills: Co-develops organisational strategy with the leadership team at Topflight Travel Group
Leads technology strategy on a rolling five-year horizon with senior leadership
Owns the systems behind €50M+ in annual turnover
Owns critical technology procurement and vendor delivery, and makes sure the value is real
MSc Leadership, Innovation and Technology, First Class Honours
agents.story: Robert sits at the leadership table as well as the keyboard. He helps set the group's strategy, owns the technology that carries more than €50M a year, and plans five years out. His MSc research looked at what makes software outsourcing actually work.

agents.title: CTO
agents.pitch: Runs the control tower. Decides what gets built, then helps build it.
skills: CTO at Topflight Travel Group since 2014, after joining as an engineer in 2011
Moved the business from on-premise and bare metal to the cloud with 100% uptime through the move
Replatformed core reservation and web systems from a legacy monolith to microservices with React, with sub-second page loads
Introduced agentic AI workflows and AI-assisted review for a measured 3× gain in engineering throughput
Leads and mentors developers, systems engineers and UI/UX practitioners, plus specialist partners
agents.story: Trained in sound technology and music performance, then ran support teams for a wireless ISP, administered systems for a national publisher and learned web development on the job. He joined Topflight in 2011 as a systems and software engineer, became technical project manager in 2012 and CTO in 2014. He's still hands-on.

agents.title: Project Manager
agents.pitch: Walks the line with the board. Clears blockers before they become problems.
skills: Technical Project Manager at Topflight Travel Group from 2012 to 2014
Embedded Lean, Kanban, Scrumban and Agile ways of working across delivery and operations
Runs the full lifecycle, from discovery and design workshops through testing, release and operations
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
Trained with Toyota and presented at EU-Japan Lean best-practice visits
agents.story: Robert learned flow from the people who invented it. He trained with Toyota, earned a Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, and built a lean, high-output engineering function around Kanban and Scrumban.

agents.title: Product Designer
agents.pitch: Turns rough ideas into something people can actually use.
skills: Runs discovery and design workshops at the start of the work, not the end
Leads a team that includes UI/UX practitioners
Replatformed customer-facing reservation and web apps with modern React interfaces
Built websites and digital advertising campaigns at Eumom
agents.story: Good products start in a workshop, not a code editor. Robert runs the discovery sessions, then works with UI/UX people to turn them into interfaces customers can use without thinking.

agents.title: Backend Engineer
agents.pitch: Down in the machine room, shaping raw data into things that work.
skills: Hands-on in Java, Python and Perl
Spring Boot, Hibernate, MyBatis and Django
PostgreSQL, MSSQL and MySQL
API design, service-oriented architecture and microservices
Helped move the Eumom platform from Classic ASP to .NET and C#
agents.story: Robert started at Topflight as a systems and software engineer in 2011, and the reservation systems he now runs are ones he has worked on from the inside. He led their move from a legacy monolith to services and microservices.

agents.title: Frontend Engineer
agents.pitch: Builds the part people see and makes it feel fast.
skills: Rebuilt reservation and web front ends in React with sub-second page loads
JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js and Vue.js
Self-taught web developer
Built company websites and campaigns at Eumom
agents.story: Robert taught himself web development and never stopped. The latest round was moving business-critical booking flows onto modern React front ends that load in under a second.

agents.title: Full Stack Engineer
agents.pitch: Runs between both ends of the stack carrying whatever is needed.
skills: Hands-on from the database to the browser, SQL to React
Builds data pipelines, BI, and statistical and machine learning models
BSc project: an automated machine learning app that predicts and recommends selling prices
Docker, CI/CD and automation to tie it all together
agents.story: Most CTOs pick a lane. Robert still works across all of them, from schema and services to pipelines, models and the interface on top.

agents.title: QA and Test Engineer
agents.pitch: Will not let an unexplained error go. Not even one odd log line.
skills: Introduced automated delivery pipelines and AI-assisted review
Owns testing and release as part of the full delivery lifecycle
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt: measure it, find the root cause, fix it for good
Spots patterns and anomalies other people scroll past
agents.story: Robert describes himself as skeptical, diligent and a bit of a worrier. In QA those are features. If something odd shows up in a log, he wants to know why.

agents.title: Systems, DevOps and IT
agents.pitch: First responder for the systems he built. Yes, even at 2am.
skills: Moved everything from on-premise and bare metal to AWS and GCP with 100% uptime, enabling fully remote operations
CI/CD, Jenkins, Docker, Linux and networking
Checks everything is up roughly hourly, evenings and weekends included
IT Systems Administrator for 60+ staff at Harmonia Publishing
Built and led the support and installation teams at ICE Broadband, a wireless ISP
agents.story: Robert is first responder for the systems he built. He has redeployed at 2am after a memory leak and taken heap dumps to find out exactly why it happened, so it wouldn't happen again.

agents.title: Cybersecurity
agents.pitch: Guards the perimeter. Suspicious traffic does not get a second chance.
skills: Leads security, data protection and cyber security practice at Topflight Travel Group
Data Protection Officer, responsible for GDPR compliance
Incident readiness and ISO 27001-aligned controls
Blocks suspicious traffic out of hours when it shows up
agents.story: Security is part of Robert's day job, not a side project. He is the Data Protection Officer, runs ISO 27001-aligned controls, and keeps watch out of hours.
